# LibreOffice Impress GUI Interface Description

## System and Application Header
- **Top Bar**: Displays system information including "Activities" on the left, "LibreOffice Impress" as the active application, and the current date and time "Oct 22 23:45" on the right.
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, maximize, and close buttons are located in the top-right corner of the window.

## Application Menu Bar
- **Menu Options**: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Slide, Slide Show, Tools, Window, Help.
- **Insert Menu**: The "Insert" menu is highlighted, indicating it is currently selected or hovered over.

## Toolbars
- **Main Toolbar**: Contains icons for common actions such as:
  - New document
  - Open document
  - Save document
  - Print
  - Cut, copy, paste
  - Undo, redo
  - Find and replace
  - Font formatting (bold, italic, underline)
  - Alignment tools
  - Drawing tools (shapes, lines, arrows)
  - Text box and object insertion
  - Slide layout and master view controls
- **Secondary Toolbar**: Located below the main toolbar, contains additional formatting and editing tools.

## Sidebar Panels
### Slides Panel
- **Location**: Left side of the interface.
- **Content**: Displays thumbnails of all slides in the presentation.
- **Slide 1**: Shows a preview of the title slide with the Columbus Police logo and the title "The Background Investigation Process".
- **Slide 2**: Contains a flowchart or diagram with multiple boxes and arrows.
- **Slide 3**: Features a magnifying glass icon and images of documents or forms.
- **Slide 4**: Displays a slide with a gray striped background and text content.
- **Slide Indicator**: At the bottom of the panel, it shows "Slide 1 of 4 (3)", indicating the current slide and total number of slides.

### Properties Panel
- **Location**: Right side of the interface.
- **Panel Title**: "Properties" with a collapsible arrow.
- **Slide Properties Section**:
  - **Format**: "On-screen w (4:3)" with a dropdown menu.
  - **Orientation**: "Landscape" with a dropdown menu.
  - **Background**: "None" with a dropdown menu and an "Insert Image..." button.
  - **Master Slide**: "Title Slide" with a dropdown menu.
  - **Master Background**: Checkbox is checked.
  - **Master Objects**: Checkbox is checked.
  - **Master View**: Button to access master view.
- **Layouts Section**:
  - **Title**: "Layouts" with a collapsible arrow.
  - **Layout Options**: Displays a grid of layout templates with purple and gray placeholders for content areas.
  - **Selected Layout**: The second layout from the top row is highlighted with a red border.

## Main Presentation Area
- **Slide Content**:
  - **Left Side**: Features the Columbus Police Department logo with the text "RESPECT INTEGRITY DISCIPLINE ENTHUSIASM PROFESSIONALISM" around the emblem.
  - **Right Side**: Displays the Human Resources Bureau logo with the text "HUMAN RESOURCES BUREAU" and "BACKGROUND INVESTIGATION SECTION" around the emblem.
  - **Background Image**: A cityscape of Columbus, Ohio, with a red horizontal line at the bottom.
  - **Text**: "The Background Investigation Process" in large blue font.
  - **Footer**: "THE CITY OF COLUMBUS" with "ANDREW J. GINTHER, MAYOR" and "DIVISION OF POLICE" in smaller text.
  - **Slide Number**: "1" in the bottom right corner.

## Status Bar
- **Location**: Bottom of the interface.
- **Content**:
  - **Slide Information**: "Slide 1 of 4 (3)".
  - **Position**: "-8.31 / -4.25" (likely coordinates or position values).
  - **Size**: "0.00 x 0.00" (likely dimensions or size values).
  - **Language**: "English (USA)".
  - **Zoom Level**: "107%" with a zoom slider and +/- buttons for adjusting zoom.

## Notification Banner
- **Location**: Top of the main presentation area.
- **Content**:
  - **Message**: "Help us make LibreOffice even better!" and "Your donations support our worldwide community."
  - **Buttons**: "Get involved" and "Donate" buttons.
  - **Close Button**: An "X" button to close the notification banner.

## Desktop Environment
- **Left Sidebar**: Contains application icons for:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
